chartExamples.describe: Scatter plot "Ad spend vs. signups". 12 points of signups against spend, in 3 groups (Search, Social, Video). Correlation 0.71 (strong positive). signups ranges from 150 to 720.
Pie chart "Where the budget goes". 5 slices totalling $12,500,000. Largest: Engineering (43.2%). The top 3 (Engineering, Sales, Marketing) make up 83.2%.
Donut chart "Traffic by source". 5 slices totalling 97.8K. Largest: Organic (49.3%). The top 3 (Organic, Direct, Referral) make up 84.3%.
Histogram "API response time". 200 values of ms in 13 bins of width 10. Mean 126.9, median 122, range 80 to 201. Most common bin: 120 to 130 (34 values).

Box plot "Delivery time by carrier". Distribution of days for 3 groups (Aero, Bolt, Cargo). Aero: median 4.15, middle half 3.3 to 4.48, range 2 to 9.4, 1 outlier. Bolt: median 4.1, middle half 3.32 to 5.23, range 2.9 to 14, 1 outlier. Cargo: median 5.55, middle half 4.53 to 7.2, range 3.6 to 14.6, 1 outlier.
